Small-n shapes (n in {32,176,352}) are dominated by torch.geqrf launch overhead and per-panel relaunches, yet count equally in the geomean. FP32; pass rankdef/clustered/nearcollinear guards. Maximize batch occupancy across the 20-40 matrices per shape.

All 22 tests + 3 guards pass. n=176/352 still on geqrf (register tile spills there). Geomean 115742->93610us.

SUGGESTED NEXT: the small-n lever is largely exhausted on this GPU; bigger geomean gains live in the n=512/1024 shapes (7 of 12, ~960ms/220ms each).
